sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 260. Deal magic damage (Water) 5 times that penetrates damage reduction and damage reflection effects with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 140. Blinds for 40 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 120. Applies Beguilement for 40 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Magic Penalty for 40 seconds with a success value of 100.
-Target: yourself. Applies Twilight for 120 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 40000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 40000
All Element Defense from Unison Damage +300

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: yourself. Applies Ambush for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; reduces the cooldown time of Abilities to 0 (except for certain Abilities); nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies frenzy (nullifies debuffs, nullifies status ailments, permits piercing through damage reduction and damage reflection) for 120 seconds.
Only [Best Pals] Darkness & Chris can be used as Unlocking Potential material
